description: Typed probability judgements about a post's audio (speech presence, intelligibility, relevance to its prompt). PLATFORM enrichment owned by Antiphony, stored as its own record referencing the post by StrongRef — the same pattern as dev.antiphony.audio.transcript. Lifted into dev.antiphony.embed.audio#view.assessment at read time; never stored on the post itself.

main.description: The assessment enrichment record for one post.

subject.description: The post this assessment evaluates (uri + cid).

sets.description: Named question sets and versions evaluated in this pass.

answers.description: Typed probability distributions keyed by stable question id.

model.description: Identifier of the model/provider that produced this assessment (provenance).

view.description: The read-time view of an assessment lifted into dev.antiphony.embed.audio#view.assessment (omits `subject`, which is already the enclosing post).

sets.description: Named question sets and versions evaluated in this pass.

answers.description: Typed probability distributions keyed by stable question id.

model.description: Identifier of the model/provider that produced this assessment (provenance).

setRef.description: Identifies a question set and its version so prompt edits stay distinguishable from model changes.

version.description: Monotonic version of the question set prompts.

answer.description: Probability distribution for a single assessment question.

top.description: The option with the highest probability (convenience, not a verdict).

distribution.description: Per-option probability mass in per-mille integers.

option.description: One allowed answer option and its per-mille probability.

value.description: Option label (`true`/`false` for booleans, choice value, or score string).

probability.description: Per-mille probability (0–1000). AT Protocol data has no floats.
